verdict.rationale: Poke has no separate custom-assistant builder. Its Recipes come closest: users can package setups and share them with others (poke-docs-28), publish them with a share link (poke-docs-17, poke-docs-38), and configure an inputContext and a prefilled first message (poke-docs-40). Knowledge and tools can be added through MCP servers (poke-docs-3), but these Recipes extend the one Poke assistant rather than creating distinct assistants. Missing for 10: distinct custom assistants with their own persistent instructions/persona, uploadable knowledge bases beyond MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
